note: arms v1 (2026-10-12): the upper arm below the shoulder ball, elbow, forearm, wrist and palm root as one tube (post step). World units. mask: the arm's vertices (x beyond xGap[0] + max(0, xGap[1] - z) * xGap[2], y below yMax, z in [zBottom, zTop]); axis: slice centroids every step, smoothed, densified; grid: (s, angle) cells (ds, na), smoothing sAlong (world) along the axis and aAround (cells) around it; taper: rows of axis z and mean radius (natural spline); weight: fade in from in[0] to in[1] and out from out[0] to out[1] (axis z); relax: Taubin on the moved vertices; spots: Laplacian smoothing spheres (mirrored) at the armpit facets.
